cards.text: Jesus is passing by, and He sees a man who has been blind since the day he was born. His disciples have a question about it, and it's a heavy one: 'Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?'

cards.question: The disciples give Jesus two choices for who sinned: the man or his parents. Which one does Jesus pick?

cards.text: Jesus says this happened 'so that the works of God would be displayed in him.' They asked about the PAST, and Jesus points them to the work right in front of them: 'we must do the works of Him who sent Me.'

cards.question: Jesus says night is coming, when no one can work. While He is in the world, what does He say He is?

cards.text: Then Jesus spits on the ground, makes some mud, and puts it on the man's eyes. No waiting room, no clipboard, no 'the doctor will see you in forty-five minutes.'

cards.question: With mud on the man's eyes, Jesus tells him to go wash in the Pool of ___.
Siloam means 'Sent.' True or false: the man goes, washes, and comes back seeing.

cards.text: The neighbors who used to see him begging can't agree: some say it's him, and others say, 'No, he just looks like him.' Friend, the man gets his sight back and the whole street acts like he showed up with a TWIN.

cards.question: While the neighbors argue about who he is, what does the man keep saying?

cards.text: So they ask how his eyes got opened. He tells them the man they call Jesus made mud, put it on his eyes and sent him to wash in Siloam: 'So I went and washed and received my sight.'

cards.question: The neighbors ask where Jesus is. True or false: the man knows exactly where to find Him.

cards.text: He says, 'I do not know.' To be fair, friend, the last time Jesus was standing in front of him, he couldn't SEE Him.

So they bring the man who had been blind to the Pharisees, a group of religious leaders. And here's the detail that's about to stir things up: the day Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes was a Sabbath.

cards.question: The Pharisees ask the man how he got his sight. True or false: he refuses to tell them.

cards.text: He tells them, short and sweet: 'He put mud on my eyes, and I washed, and now I can see.' Friend, he went from the full story to the TEXT MESSAGE version.

cards.question: Some of the Pharisees say Jesus is not from God. What reason do they give?

answers.text: He does not keep the Sabbath

cards.text: But others say, 'How can a sinful man perform such signs?' Now there's division among them, like a group chat where everybody's typing at once and NOBODY agrees.

cards.question: The Pharisees turn back to the man. Since it was his eyes Jesus opened, what does he say about Jesus?

cards.text: The Jews still don't believe he was ever blind, so they summon his parents and ask, 'Is this your son, the one you say was born blind? So how is it that he can now see?' They're checking this man's story like a bank checking a SIGNATURE.

cards.question: His parents answer: we know he is our ___, and we know he was born ___.
The leaders also want to know how the man can now see. True or false: his parents tell them it was Jesus who opened his eyes.

cards.text: They say they don't know how he can see or who opened his eyes. 'Ask him. He is old enough to speak for himself.'

cards.question: The man's parents send every question back to their son. Why?

answers.text: They are afraid of the Jews
They are angry with their son

cards.text: Here's what has them scared: the Jews had already made a decision about anyone who confessed Jesus as the Christ.

cards.question: What had the Jews decided would happen to anyone who confessed Jesus as the Christ?

answers.text: They would be put out of the synagogue
They would be sent out of the city
They would have to pay a fine

cards.text: That's why his parents say, 'He is old enough. Ask him.' It's the move every one of us has pulled in a tense meeting: 'Great question. Let's ask HIM.'
So a second time they call in the man who had been blind, and they say, 'Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.'

cards.question: The leaders call Jesus a sinner. What does the man say he knows for sure?

answers.text: I was blind but now I see

cards.text: Whether Jesus is a sinner, he says, he doesn't know. 'There is one thing I do know: I was blind, but now I see!'

cards.question: The leaders ask AGAIN how Jesus opened his eyes. True or false: the man walks them through the whole story one more time.

cards.text: He says he already told them and they didn't listen, then he asks, 'Do you also want to become His disciples?' Friend, that's somebody asking you to resend an email, and you hit reply with a SIGN-UP FORM.

cards.question: The leaders heap insults on the man and tell him he's Jesus' disciple. Whose disciples do they say they are?

cards.text: They say, 'We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know where this man is from.' And now the whole room is waiting to see what HE says.

cards.question: The leaders say they don't even know where Jesus is from. True or false: the man decides that settles it and backs down.

cards.text: 'That is remarkable indeed!' he says. They don't know where Jesus is from, and yet He opened his eyes.
Then he reasons it out: God doesn't listen to sinners, but He does listen to the one who worships Him and does His will.

cards.question: True or false: the man says people have heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind many times before.
So the man lands his point: if Jesus were not from ___, He could do no such thing.
The man who used to sit and beg has just made his case to the leaders. What do they do with him?

cards.text: They reply, 'You were born in utter sin, and you are instructing us?' And they throw him out.
When Jesus hears they threw him out, He goes and FINDS the man, and friend, I know a little something about getting found. He asks him, 'Do you believe in the Son of Man?'

cards.question: Jesus asks the man if he believes in the Son of Man. How does the man answer?

answers.text: He asks who the Son of Man is

cards.text: He replies, 'Who is He, Sir? Tell me so that I may believe in Him.' Jesus answers, 'You have already seen Him,' and then, 'He is the One speaking with you.'

cards.question: True or false: the man says, 'Lord, I believe,' and he worships Jesus.
Then Jesus declares He came into this world for judgment, so that the ___ may see.

cards.text: And then the other side of it: 'those who see may become blind.' Let that one sit for a second, friend.

cards.question: Some of the Pharisees with Jesus hear Him say this. What do they ask Him?

cards.text: Jesus replies, 'If you were blind, you would not be guilty of sin.'

cards.question: But the Pharisees claim they can see. What does Jesus say about their guilt?

cards.text: That's where we'll let the oven rest for now, friend. Jesus isn't done talking, and you're gonna want to be here for what He says next.
